entries.name: Startup Santarém (NERSANT incubator)
entries.what: Business incubator opened in 2016 at the Escola Prática de Cavalaria with the council, with about 80 companies in physical and virtual incubation. Accredited in October 2025 as a Local Incubator in the national network, with three sister sites at Alcanena, Torres Novas and Ourém. The pages we read give no application steps.

entries.name: RIBA, Centre for Impact Entrepreneurship
entries.what: NERSANT and Adorior programme for startups with a cultural, social or environmental aim in Médio Tejo and Lezíria do Tejo: incubation, acceleration, training. It aimed to support 111 entrepreneurs over three years from January 2025.

entries.name: Startup Portugal: One Stop Shop for founders and the national incubator network
entries.what: The national startup agency's page for founders points to funding, visas and programmes, and to the RNi network of accredited incubators, which includes Santarém's.

entries.name: Empresa na Hora (state counters, Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado)
entries.what: A national scheme to set up a private limited, single-person or public limited company on the spot at a counter. The page lists no locations, so we do not say which counter serves Santarém.

entries.name: PRR recovery funds into ISLA Inteligente
entries.what: 100,000 euros of Recovery and Resilience Plan grant for ISLA Santarém's AI ecosystem project, running 2026 to 2027.

entries.name: Portugal Inovação Social into RIBA
entries.what: Finances RIBA, the impact-entrepreneurship centre of NERSANT and Adorior, alongside the two intermunicipal communities and private investors. Total investment above 500,000 euros.

entries.name: AIPFL
entries.what: International project using AI for hair and skin treatments, showcased by Startup Santarém in April 2024. The page says no more, so its current status is unknown.

entries.name: Setúbal council: Gabinete de Apoio ao Empresário (GAE)
entries.what: The council's business support office, which its contacts page describes as help with creating companies, information on legislation and incentives. It sits at the Mercado do Livramento and opens on weekdays, with a lunch break. Its own page (economia-2/gae) answered 404, so the description comes from the council's contacts page.

entries.name: Setúbal council: Ninho de Novas Iniciativas Empresariais (NNIES)
entries.what: A municipal business nest for new service-sector companies with growth potential, mainly in the historic centre. Offers a private or shared office of about 25 square metres, a virtual address and coworking. Open to firms incorporated under a year ago and operating under six months. Applications are taken all year, with a form handed in, posted or emailed. The page (read 17 November, last updated by the council on 9 October 2026) lists twenty offices, an auditorium, a training room and a meeting room, and links a regulation, an application form and a fee table; we did not open the fee table PDF. The page does not mention AI.

entries.name: IPStartUp, the Politécnico de Setúbal incubator
entries.what: Incubator at the Setúbal campus (Estefanilha) with a second site in Barreiro. IAPMEI certified it as a StartUP Visa incubator for 2026, a route for foreign founders. Its incubation page (read 17 November) says applications are open to founders in every field, from technology to social sciences and creative projects, with mentoring, business-plan support, networking and help finding funding; an online form is evaluated by the team, and a rules document and a fee schedule are linked from the page. It does not mention AI. A 2 to 5 November 2026 exchange at the University of Murcia (MetaRed X) is its latest news.

entries.name: Poliempreende (regional phase at the Politécnico de Setúbal)
entries.what: The national polytechnic entrepreneurship contest. The 22nd edition's regional final on 19 May 2026 had 19 teams. The winner, a mobile app for student music groups, went on to the national final at the University of Algarve. The incubator's site lists a 23rd edition for 2026 and 2027. Its 23rd edition page (read 17 November) gives applications open from 16 October 2026 to 31 January 2027 by online form, a capacity programme of 11 workshops, a regional final at the Universidade Politécnica de Setúbal in May 2027 and the national final in Porto from 30 August to 3 September 2027.

entries.name: StartIPS: Acelerar o Futuro (IPStartUp with BGI Sustainable Ventures)
entries.what: A four-session acceleration programme held in April and May 2026 on technology and market maturity, business models, validation, funding and pitching.

entries.name: Espaço Empresa and Empresa na Hora at the Loja de Cidadão de Setúbal
entries.what: The state's company-creation desk: an Espaço Empresa on weekdays, with Empresa na Hora (a company set up in one visit) by appointment only, booked in person, by phone or by email as the page publishes.

entries.name: Industrial and business parks of Setúbal
entries.what: The council's economy page lists the Mitrena industrial zone (no municipal lots left, all sold at auction), Sapec Bay (about 400 hectares), the BlueBiz business park (56 hectares, automotive-oriented), IMA Park and EIRA Park (60 units of 200 to 2,000 square metres).

entries.name: Startup Portugal (national programmes)
entries.what: The national startup agency lists programmes such as Tech Foundry Portugal Deep Tech Edition and a one-stop shop for funding and visas. Its home page has no Setúbal-specific entry and names no Setúbal members of the national incubator network.

entries.name: Portos de Setúbal e Lisboa: own AI and datacenter budget
entries.what: About 750 thousand euros as reported by O Setubalense: roughly 700 thousand for a shared datacenter planned for the second half of 2026 and 52 thousand for the staff AI project. Public money spent by the ports authority itself, not an outside investment.
entries.amount: about 750 thousand euros (52 thousand for the AI project)

entries.name: GEL, the council's local entrepreneurship office
entries.what: Informs entrepreneurs about support, links them to public or private institutions, advises on the rules for EU and other funding, and helps local producers.

entries.name: Digital-transition funding calls listed by the council
entries.what: The council's calls page lists national funding such as Smart PME (Industry 4.0), Coaching 4.0 and vouchers for startups with green and digital products. The titles name no AI and the page gives no dates, so check each call at its source.

entries.name: Coworking spaces in São Marcos da Serra and São Bartolomeu de Messines
entries.what: The council says it opened these at the end of 2021. A 2025 opinion column said Silves had no incubator, accelerator or business centre, so we could confirm none of those.

entries.name: Municipal tax exemptions for innovative or creative investment
entries.what: The council says it has granted tax exemptions since at least mid-2017 to investment projects such as innovative or creative activities, job creation, local products and energy efficiency.

entries.name: Antrix and Carvoeiro Branco: purchase of the Fábrica do Inglês
entries.what: Two Algarve property developers bought the 1894 cork factory, empty since 2009, to reopen the cork museum, add a boutique hotel and move their offices there. Not AI.

entries.name: Balcão do Empreendedor (ePortugal), reached through the council
entries.what: The council says the services it must provide to carry out an economic activity go through the national single desk, run by AMA. The page does not describe Empresa na Hora or a startup visa.

entries.name: CTVC cooperative incubator (Viana do Castelo)
entries.what: A cooperative of early-stage tech startups that pool shared infrastructure, events, funding-call information and reduced-rate staff support, for 150 euros a year, with no equity taken. It wants a scalable tech product, a prototype or first pilots, and at least one cofounder tied to Viana. Applications use a form on its page.

entries.name: Viana S.T.ARTS Centre (VianaStarts)
entries.what: The council's science, technology and arts centre in the former slaughterhouse. Its page does not say whether it is an incubator or what it offers, and gives no opening date.

entries.name: Viana Tech Day Pitch Battle
entries.what: Entrepreneurs pitched ideas to a jury of investors and sector professionals on 6 November 2026 at the Santa Luzia elevator. Applications closed on 23 October. A panel looked at what became of earlier pitches.

entries.name: Dinamo10 Creative Hub
entries.what: Hosted the Think Tank Viana STARTS on Viana Tech Day 2026 in its space. Its own services were not read.

entries.name: Business parks managed with the council (Praia Norte, Meadela, Lanheses, Neiva)
entries.what: The council lists four business parks and zones, with Lanheses run by Gestinviana, in which the council is a shareholder. Meadela and Neiva have no description. No technology park is listed.

entries.name: Local business associations (AEVC, AIMINHO, CEVAL and others)
entries.what: The council's list of business associations in the area. None is described as a technology or startup body.

entries.name: Recovery and Resilience Plan (PRR) into the IPVC and Data CoLAB AI project
entries.what: About 39,800 euros of funding for a project that used AI, natural language processing and generative AI to build an interactive digital system. The portal page showed a data-loading error.

entries.name: CTS Group and Eaton into Nordic Epod's Viana plant
entries.what: A joint venture investing 50 million euros in a factory for data-centre power units, with 500 jobs expected. The sources never mention AI.

entries.name: K-Bridge (student startup project)
entries.what: AI platform from three IPVC business students to help companies retain operational knowledge. A contest entry, with no company or funding stated.

entries.name: Vicentina, development association of the southwest (LEADER local action group, Adere programmes)
entries.what: Regional development association whose funding calls have covered Vila do Bispo with Aljezur and Monchique. A 2020 call, +CO3SO Emprego Interior, funded job creation including self-employment in micro and small firms in low-density areas, 2.0 million euros across three measures. The call is old, so check what is open now.

entries.name: European Innovation Council Accelerator, investment in Sea4Us
entries.what: About 5.6 million euros from the EIC Accelerator for the Sagres marine biotech company, as reported by Barlavento in December 2023.

entries.name: CRESC Algarve 2020, funding for Sea4Us
entries.what: About 1.3 million euros of regional programme funding reported for Sea4Us.

entries.name: Horizon 2020 SME Instrument phase 1, Sea4Pain feasibility study
entries.what: EU contribution of 50,000 euros (total cost 71,429 euros) to Sea4Us for a feasibility study, 1 May to 30 September 2018.

entries.name: Fosteam@South, Recovery and Resilience funding for the Sagres marine laboratory
entries.what: About 2.1 million euros of Recovery and Resilience Plan money for the Universidade do Algarve, CCMAR and municipality marine biology laboratory at Porto da Baleeira, as reported in June 2023.

entries.name: Portugal 2030 and Algarve 2030, digitalisation of municipal services
entries.what: EU support of 643,582.75 euros to the Municipality of Vila do Bispo on an eligible cost of 1,072,637.94 euros, project ALGARVE-FEDER-03054600.

entries.name: Portugal 2030 and Algarve 2030, smart urban waste management
entries.what: EU support of 263,835 euros to the Municipality of Vila do Bispo on an eligible cost of 439,725 euros, project ALGARVE-FEDER-03085500.

entries.name: Empresa na Hora (Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado)
entries.what: Counters where all partners together can set up a limited company, sole-owner company or public limited company in one visit, choosing a pre-approved name and articles. National service, with the Vila Real counter not checked.

entries.name: Startup Portugal
entries.what: The national startup agency's site lists programmes, a founder's guide, a network of recognised incubators (RNi) and a startups and investors matching tool. National, not a Vila Real desk.

entries.name: Regia Douro Park (science and technology park with an incubator and accelerator)
entries.what: The park, with about 160 companies, hosts an incubator and accelerator. Its own site was in maintenance mode, so the details come from a Lusa report.

entries.name: Vila Real Innovation Hub (Regia Douro Park with UTAD)
entries.what: A community for remote workers, freelancers and digital entrepreneurs. More than 50 had registered by May 2026. The park says it may add services such as temporary housing.

entries.name: INOV_TECH@UTAD business ideas contest
entries.what: Contest for ideas by members of the UTAD community aged 18 to 29 with a tax address in the North, Centre or Alentejo regions. Ten ideas go to a validation lab, five to an acceleration and mentoring programme, and the top three share 6,000 euros. The page shown is the 2025 edition.

entries.name: UPGRADE 2026 (UTAD, project UI-TRANSFER 2.0)
entries.what: 50 thousand euros for five proof-of-concept projects of up to 10 thousand euros, in goods and services, for UTAD researchers, lecturers and students. Applications closed on 28 February 2026.

entries.name: FCT into UTAD's AITriage4SU emergency triage project
entries.what: National research funding for an AI decision-support project at UTAD, about 124 thousand euros in total.

entries.name: COMPETE 2030 (ERDF) into UTAD's UPGRADE 2026 programme
entries.what: European regional funding behind the UI-TRANSFER 2.0 project, which pays for five proof-of-concept projects at UTAD.

entries.name: NORTE2030 into the EdgeOnVespa consortium
entries.what: Co-finances a 36-month project using AI and edge computing against the Asian hornet, with UTAD as a partner. The report gives no amount.

entries.name: AIRV business incubator (Expobeiras building, Coimbrões)
entries.what: Virtual and physical incubation with 34 equipped offices, regional IAPMEI and AICEP offices on site, an acceleration programme and a link to the polytechnic. Open to any sector and maturity, with priority for projects tied to the Viseu region.

entries.name: Câmara Municipal de Viseu: Gabinete do Investidor (Viseu Investe)
entries.what: The council's investor office offers a single qualified contact point, a simplified process and ongoing follow-up for productive investment projects in all sectors. A funding scheme for municipal economic initiatives (regulation and application form) sits under Viseu Investe.

entries.name: Área de Acolhimento Empresarial de Lordosa
entries.what: Council business park whose lots are to be sold by public auction soon. The page publishes the regulation and the first-phase plan and says more information will follow.

entries.name: STAR Institute: technology services and startup space
entries.what: The centre says it serves companies with product and process development, automation, robotics and AI services, and that a spin-off and two startups are installed in its building. Its pages give no application route for new startups.

entries.name: ViTeB test bed (Visabeira I&D)
entries.what: A pre-industrial test bed for SMEs and startups to develop and test products, with AI among its thematic areas. Its contact page offers a web form.

entries.name: UPV Gabinete de Transferência de Tecnologia and INOVC+
entries.what: The university's technology transfer office runs the INOVC+ ignition and proof-of-concept contest. Its third edition funded four projects on 21 July 2026 (UVC drying, 3D printing, wool insulation, foundry sand). None is about AI.

entries.name: AIRV: association and business parks
entries.what: The business association says it has over 500 member firms, 25 or more incubated firms, legal services, training and rented space. It was founded in 1982.

entries.name: COMPETE 2030 (FEDER) into RiskMap
entries.what: The project sheet lists a total incentive of 208,202.40 euros on 244,944 euros of eligible investment, of which 73,072.80 euros is the polytechnic's share.

entries.name: PRR (Recovery and Resilience Plan) into the STAR Institute building
entries.what: Observador reports 3.5 million euros from the PRR for the building of the STAR Institute, which also reports a consortium of 36 entities. The 5 million euro total in some press is not on the pages we opened.

entries.name: PRR into ViTeB (Visabeira I&D TestBed)
entries.what: Transparency portal sheet: 5.58 million euros total, all non-repayable, 3.94 million paid at the time of reading, running from 1 September 2022 to 15 June 2026, under digital transition of companies.

entries.name: PRR into the ULS Viseu Dão-Lafões imaging equipment
entries.what: 5.8 million euros contracted for heavy medical equipment and a surgical robot, with AI tools in the imaging systems where applicable.

entries.name: Viseu Investe (municipal programme)
entries.what: Council programme since 2014 to attract investment, with a regulation and application form for economic initiatives of municipal interest. The page claims 22 investments worth 132 million euros.

entries.name: ChatPlace
entries.what: Platform for creators and small businesses: AI content studio, an AI manager that answers DMs and comments 24/7, chatbot funnels and gamification on Instagram, TikTok, Telegram and WhatsApp.
entries.note: Listed for Web Summit Lisbon 2026 as a Portuguese startup.

entries.name: DIG-IN
entries.what: Maps the physical hospitality economy: a data engine tracking millions of verified outlets across Europe and Brazil with menus, pricing and location over time.
entries.note: Listed for Web Summit Lisbon 2026 as a Portuguese startup.

entries.name: iTRecruiter
entries.what: Portuguese tech recruitment ecosystem ("where technology meets people").
entries.note: Listed for Web Summit Lisbon 2026 as a Portuguese startup.

entries.name: sheerME
entries.what: Beauty and wellness super app to discover, book and pay for services.
entries.note: Listed for Web Summit Lisbon 2026 as a Portuguese startup.

entries.name: VTEX
entries.what: Global AI-native commerce platform connecting commerce, data and operations for enterprises.
entries.note: Listed for Web Summit Lisbon 2026 as a Portuguese startup.
